description: What cites a document: each corpus's citations of a code section, law, bill or order, with the words that cite it, and for a statute the regulations issued under it. Lists come 50 at a time; `list` and `offset` page through one.

citation.description: A citation ("26 U.S.C. 61(a)", "40 CFR 60.1", "Pub. L. 119-21", "H.R. 1", "E.O. 14000"). Give this or `path`.

list.description: One list only, by the corpus that cites.

offset.description: With `list`, where in it to start.

path.description: A page of the site, as its path or full URL ("/usc/26/61", "/pl/119/21"). Give this or `citation`.

name: citations
